comparison_kind: historical, unpaired comparison; M8.2 formal replay was not run

m8_2_glm_5_3.reason: Phase 1 requires bounded diagnostics from the actual signed Agent Host. The service flag was observed only in a disposable signed fixture; the actual product Host was not started and its stderr capture path is unavailable without the root-only launchctl debug override.

comparability_limits: M7 used GLM-5.3-Flash; M8.0 and the unexecuted M8.2 configuration select GLM-5.3.
Prompt, frozen baseline, hidden-test patch, provider endpoint, request parameters, and stated budgets match for the historical M7 and M8.0 attempts.
Harness/product source commits and diagnostic code differ; hosted model weights and provider state are not pinned, and sampling is stochastic.
Observed Launcher wait intervals are not pure model latency. No causal claim or general reliability claim follows from these single historical attempts.
M8.2 has no model output or grading result, so it cannot establish either recurrence or non-recurrence of an Action Shape failure.
interpretation: M7 and M8.0 both failed the frozen coding task after successful approved operations, but at different reported Host validation categories. M8.0 proves a terminal model-output shape rejection, not the exact rejected fields or its initial-versus-correction cause. No M8.2 model behavior was observed.
